findings.quote: both the power and the protected standing of Sparta
findings.problem: Greek: τὴν δύναμιν καὶ τὴν προστασίαν καταλελύσθαι τὴν Λακεδαιμονίων. προστασία here is leadership/headship (primacy), not 'protection' or 'protected standing'.
findings.proposed_fix: both the power and the leadership of the Spartans

findings.quote: which had previously been entered against them, to be publicly proclaimed.
findings.problem: Greek breaks off here: ἃς ἦσαν πρότερον αὐτοῖς ἐπιγεγραμμένοι, * (lacuna). English runs on as if the sentence were whole.
findings.proposed_fix: which had previously been entered against them, to be publicly proclaimed [gap in the Greek]

findings.quote: Thus in one case they condemned them for sacrilege
findings.problem: Greek resumes after a second lacuna: ** καὶ τούτῳ τῷ τρόπῳ τῶν δικῶν μίαν μὲν αὐτῶν κατεδίκασαν ἱεροσυλίας. Gap not marked; 'Thus' smooths over it.
findings.proposed_fix: [gap in the Greek] ... and in this way, of the suits, in one case they condemned them for sacrilege

findings.quote: For when there was a clash over the seizure of the herds of Myrrichus and Simon
findings.problem: Greek: παραυτίκα γὰρ ἔλαχε * ** τῶν Μυρρίχου θρεμμάτων καὶ τοῦ Σίμωνος. There is a lacuna after ἔλαχε ('obtained by lot / fell to'); 'seizure' is invented and the gap is smoothed.
findings.proposed_fix: For at once [subject lost] obtained by lot [gap in the Greek] of the herds of Myrrichus and Simon; and when a clash arose over this

findings.quote: after envoys intervened and settlements were arranged
findings.problem: Greek: διαπρεσβευσαμένων *** τοῖς συναλλάγμασιν. A lacuna follows διαπρεσβευσαμένων (negotiating by embassy) and the construction with τοῖς συναλλάγμασιν is lost; English supplies a complete clause.
findings.proposed_fix: after negotiating by embassy [gap in the Greek] the agreements

units.note: Μεγαρεῖς in the Greek is as transmitted; not altered.

findings.quote: and sternly rebuked the Lycians, they declared that they would endure anything rather than do what the Rhodians ordered.
findings.problem: Greek: προσεπετίμησε τοῖς Λυκίοις *** πᾶν γὰρ ὑπομένειν ἔφασαν μᾶλλον ἢ ... A lacuna follows τοῖς Λυκίοις; the ὡς δέ clause has no main verb, and the Lycian reply is introduced by γάρ ('for'). English joins them into one smooth sentence.
findings.proposed_fix: and sternly rebuked the Lycians [gap in the Greek]; for they said that they would endure anything rather than do what the Rhodians ordered.

findings.quote: disapproved of both the treatment of the walls and the killings at Compasium
findings.problem: Greek: τῇ τῶν τειχῶν συντελέσει* καὶ τῇ καταλύσει *** τῶν ἐν τῷ Κομπασίῳ διαφθαρέντων. There is a lacuna after συντελέσει and another after καταλύσει, both unmarked in English; 'killings' replaces a gapped phrase (καταλύσις ... τῶν διαφθαρέντων, 'the putting down/ending ... of those destroyed').
findings.proposed_fix: disapproved of both the completion of the walls [gap in the Greek] and the putting down [gap in the Greek] of those who perished at Compasium

units.note: Sense of τειχῶν συντελέσει and καταλύσει is uncertain given the gaps; fix preserves that.
